text: The Olympic marathon winner rode in a car. St Louis, nineteen oh four. A hot, dusty, chaotic race. Fred Lorz quit, took a car ride for about ten miles, then ran across the finish line first. The real winner’s trainers fed him rat poison and brandy. Another runner ate rotten apples, and took a nap mid race. Lorz was caught and disqualified. And the apple napper still finished fourth. Which runner is the real legend?
